HSP.why: LP exhaust hood water spray of the TCS: FV-CD1904 opens fully below 15 % load (IBD TC-28 / TC-35) and cools the hood (TEST11101 ~ 3) against the windage of the blades at speed. START = put the spray in AUTO (PR-OPE-5002 6307, with the vacuum up). STOP = out of service. ATS 1.12: hood below 80 C, below 52 C before load up.
